title: Core: keyboard shortcut action dispatcher
description: Implement a keyboard shortcut system in packages/authoring-ui/src/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts. Hook: useKeyboardShortcuts({ onUndo, onRedo, onCopy, onPaste, onPasteInPlace, onDelete, onSelectAll, onDeselect, onGroup, onUngroup, onBringToFront, onSendToBack }). Wire up standard Flash 8 shortcuts: Ctrl+Z=undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z=redo, Ctrl+C=copy, Ctrl+V=paste, Ctrl+Shift+V=pasteInPlace, Delete/Backspace=delete, Ctrl+A=selectAll, Ctrl+G=group, Ctrl+Shift+G=ungroup, F5=insertFrame, F6=insertKeyframe, F7=insertBlankKeyframe. Returns nothing; uses useEffect. Add unit tests.
